title: hybrid.rs: MeshPrefix::contains panics on prefix_len >= 136 (duplicate)
description: Line 162-166: full_bytes = prefix_len / 8 can exceed 16 when prefix_len >= 136, causing index out-of-bounds panic on addr[..full_bytes]. No validation exists in MeshPrefix::new or add_mesh_prefix. Valid IPv6 prefix lengths are 0-128.
close_reason: MeshPrefix::new rejects prefix_len>128 (Option); contains() fail-closes without panic for 129..=255 so full_bytes never exceeds 16. Tests cover /32,/33,/128 and invalid 129/136/255. add_mesh_prefix ignores invalid lengths.
